hooks.command: rpi_root="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$rpi_root/.codex/hooks/guard-bash.sh" ] && [ "$rpi_root" != / ]; do rpi_root=${rpi_root%/*}; rpi_root=${rpi_root:-/}; done; if [ ! -f "$rpi_root/.codex/hooks/guard-bash.sh" ]; then printf "%s\n" "RPI POLICY SKIPPED: no installed policy wrapper above the hook cwd." >&2; exit 0; fi; exec bash "$rpi_root/.codex/hooks/guard-bash.sh" codex
